string-array.name: hare_krishna_mantra
string-array.item:
Hare Krishna Hare Krishna
Krishna Krishna Hare Hare
Hare Rama Hare Rama
Rama Rama Hare Hare

हरे कृष्ण हरे कृष्ण,
कृष्ण कृष्ण हरे हरे ।
हरे राम हरे राम,
राम राम हरे हरे ।।

string-array.name: gayatri_mantra
string-array.item: Om bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ, tat savitur vareṇyaṃ, bhargo devasya dhīmahi, dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt.
ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं\nभर्गो देवस्य धीमहि धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात्

string-array.name: mahamrutyunjay
string-array.item: Om Tryambakam yajaamahe sugandhim pushtivardhanam\nUrvaarukamiva bandhanaan-mrityormuksheeya maamritaat
ॐ त्र्य॑म्बकं यजामहे सु॒गन्धिं॑ पुष्टि॒वर्ध॑नम् । उ॒र्वा॒रु॒कमि॑व॒ बन्ध॑नान्मृ॒त्योर्मु॑क्षीय॒ मामृता॑त् ॥

string-array.name: shree_ram
string-array.item: Shri Ram Jay Ram Jay Jay Ram
श्री राम जय राम जय जय राम

string-array.name: hanuman_beeja
string-array.item: Om Aim Bhreem Hanumate\nShree Ram Dootaaya Namaha
ॐ ऐं भ्रीम हनुमते\nश्री राम दूताय नमः

string-array.name: om_saha_vavatu_prayer
string-array.item:
Om saha naavavatu,
 saha nau bhunaktu,
 saha viiryam karavaavahai,
 tejasvinaa vadhiitam astu maa vidvissaavahai,
 aum shaanti shaanti shaanti.

ॐ सह नाववतु ।
 सह नौ भुनक्तु ।
 सह वीर्यं करवावहै ।
 तेजस्वि नावधीतमस्तु मा विद्विषावहै ।
 ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥

string-array.name: before_studies_prayer
string-array.item: sarasvati namas-tubhyam varade kaama-ruupini,\n vidyaarambham karisyaami siddhir-bhavatu me sadaa.

string-array.name: upon_waking_prayer
string-array.item: karāgre vasate lakṣmiḥ karamadhye sarasvati\n karamūle tu govindaḥ prabhāte karadarśanam

string-array.name: sri_ganesah_prayer
string-array.item: ekadantam mahaakaayam lambodara gajaananam,\n vighna-naasa-karam devam herambam pranamaamyaham

string-array.name: sri_hanuman_prayer
string-array.item: manojavam maaruta-tulya-vegam jitendriyam buhhdi-mataam varistham, vaatatmajam vaanara-yuutha mukhyam sri-raama-duutam sirasaa namaamim

string-array.name: maha_mrtyunjaya_prayer
string-array.item:
Om Tryambakam yajaamahe
sugandhim pushtivardhanam
Urvaa-ruka-miva bandhanaan
mrityor-muksheeya maamritaat
ॐ त्र्य॑म्बकं यजामहे सु॒गन्धिं॑ पुष्टि॒वर्ध॑नम् । उ॒र्वा॒रु॒कमि॑व॒ बन्ध॑नान्मृ॒त्योर्मु॑क्षीय॒ मामृता॑त् ॥

string-array.name: bhojanaat_praak_prayer
string-array.item:
(Gita verses chanted before taking food)

 yadaaditya-gatam tejah jagad-bhaasayate-khilam
 yac-candramadi yac-caagnau tat-tejo viddhi maamakam (15-12)

 gaamaavisya ca bhuutaani dhaarayaamyaham-ojasaa
 pusnaami causadhiih sarvaah somo bhuutvaa rasaatmakah (15-13)

 aham vaisvaanaro bhuutvaa praaninaam deham-aasritah
 praanaapaana-samaayuktak pacaamyannam catur-vidham (15-14)

 sarva dharmaan parityajya maamekam saranam vraja
 aham tvaa sarva-paapebhyo moksayisyaami maa sucah (18-66)

 brahmaarpanam brahma havih
 brahmaagnau brahmanaa hutam
 brahmaiva-tena gantavyam
 brahma-karma-samaadhinaa (4-24)

string-array.name: sayana_samaye_prayer
string-array.item:
(Night prayer before sleeping for forgiveness)

 kara-carana-krtam vaak-kaayajam karmajam vaa
 sravana-nayanojam vaa maanasam vaaparaadham
 vihita-mavihitam vaa sarva-metat ksamasva
 jaya jaya karunaabdhe srii-mahaadeva sambho

string-array.name: sivadhyanam_prayer
string-array.item:
namaste astu bhagavan visvesvaraaya maha-devaaya
 tryambakaaya tripuraantakaaya trikaalaagni-kaalaaya
 kaalaagni-rudraaya niila-kanthaaya mrtyunjayaaya
 sarvesvaraaya sadaasivaaya sriiman mahaadevaaya namah
